findings.title: Bloquear las métricas internas anónimas bajo /grafana/
findings.evidence: New ALB and CloudFront routes forward /grafana/metrics; existing deny_metrics only covers /metrics. Grafana metrics auth is separate from auth.anonymous, and metrics configuration is not overridden.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated public access to Grafana internal telemetry; no claim of access to dashboards, Atlas data or passwords.
findings.basis: Source inspection and official Grafana configuration documentation
findings.requested_change: Disable Grafana internal metrics, deny its public metrics paths, or configure separate authenticated metrics; add a failing anonymous regression check.

operational_delta: The human 30 EUR ceiling was withdrawn for the master account; the immutable candidate still contains the former guard and requires a later reviewed adaptation. No Pontia limits assumed.
